text: The Beginner project connected Power BI straight to SQL Server. This project's load step is different, because the real combined dataset only exists as a DataFrame produced by a Python script.

In Power BI Desktop, Get Data, More, Other, Python script opens an editor where Power Query actually runs a Python script and treats any pandas DataFrame left in memory afterward as a navigable table.
The same script from Lessons five and six gets pasted in as-is. Nothing about the cleaning logic changes just because it's now running inside Power Query.
Once the script finishes, the Navigator shows every DataFrame left in memory: customer_df, territory_df, and combined_df. Only combined_df gets selected and loaded into the model.
Power BI will re-run this entire script on every refresh, start to finish. That detail matters a lot later. Next lesson builds the star-schema data model on top of combined_df.
